# Monsters of the Gates on film (SPEC §60), reel pick of 1: sand_stalker, glint_mite, sleepwalker, the_tall_one, silent_stalker, the_unblinking, the_lamplighter, gel_sample.
# Each is filmed close from the side with the clip recorder: standing, closing on a dummy and striking it (its string
# of blows, the closing circle of each), acting each of its moves (its own shots in flight, its matter, its opening),
# and dying. Clips: run-autopilot/clips/<id>_<idle|fight|m0..|death>; sheets: python3 -I tools/ascent/clip.py <clip>.
# GENERATED by `python3 tools/art/specs/gate_monsters.py film`: edit that, not this.
